verdict.rationale: PostHog's hosted, OAuth-gated MCP server exposes a feature-flags tool family (27 tools), and its docs say agents can "ship a feature flag from a prompt." A documented agent example creates a flag and rolls it out to users with an @example.com email, which covers targeting. Flag docs confirm targeting by person property, cohort, or group, plus turning a flag off without a redeploy. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the specific create/update/toggle MCP tool names or REST flag endpoints, and independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven flag management.
